raw.query: SELECT r.run_id, r.encoder_delay_p99_ms, r.provisioned_worker_seconds, c8.provisioned_worker_seconds AS c8_seconds, (r.provisioned_worker_seconds / c8.provisioned_worker_seconds) AS cost_ratio FROM provenance.encoder_run_summary r JOIN provenance.encoder_run_summary c8 ON c8.run_id = 'a13:ft_static_C8' WHERE r.run_id = 'a13:ft_reactive_L30'
raw.claimed: 0.687x static C=8 cost ratio, 588 ms encoder p99
raw.evidence: Run a13:ft_reactive_L30 achieves a cost ratio of 0.6868x (rounds to 0.687x) relative to the C=8 baseline (a13:ft_static_C8) over the full 7-day trace while holding encoder p99 at 588.37 ms (rounds to 588 ms). gpt-5.6-sol incorrectly referenced weekly aggregate runs instead of full-trace ones.
